ns2:section.sectionText: Spring ME 470 registration is for students whose UIN ends in an odd number. To petition a change in this spring registration, please contact MechSE Undergraduate Programs Office (mechse-ug-advise@illinois.edu). You will receive a TIME CONFLICT AND AN APPROVAL ERROR when registering for this course. To receive the necessary overrides to register, please contact MechSE Undergraduate Programs Office (mechse-ug-advise@illinois.edu). This section will have distributed classroom attendance (some attending Tuesday mornings and others Thursday mornings) with supplemental instruction. You will receive an email from our department with specific attendance directives.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Senior class standing.
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Mechanical Sci & Engineering department.
